history.summary: IDENTITY CONFIRMED: this is the Ibudhou Pakhangba Laishang (Iputhou Pakhangba Laishang) inside the Kakching Garden at Uyok Ching, just south of Kakching Market in Kakching district, Manipur - a traditional Sanamahi (Meitei indigenous religion) shrine, NOT a conventional Hindu temple. The shrine stands just next to the entrance gate of the Kakching Garden tourist centre (which also holds a shrine of goddess Haoreima Sampubi, a Shiva shrine, rose garden, parks and restaurants), is built in traditional Meitei architecture, and houses a serpentine dragon statue of God Pakhangba in the temple hall; visitors offer fruits and flowers to seek blessings. This is one of several Pakhangba shrines across Manipur (others at Kangla, Uyal Cheirao Ching, Moirang area) and must not be conflated with the Kangla Pakhangba Temple in Imphal. name: Ibudhou Pakhang Laiseng, Kakching Garden
town_description: Kakching is a market town in Kakching district of Manipur, about 44 km south of Imphal. It is known for the Kakching Garden tourist centre at Uyok Ching on the hill south of the town market, which houses several religious shrines including this Pakhangba shrine, along with parks, a rose garden and restaurants, drawing visitors from across Manipur.
